scope: Implicit source functions, intrinsics, constants and declaration types. No std modules are imported. Contexts are separate contracts; ordinary functions are shared by interpreter and AOT. Parameters are required unless defaults explicitly say otherwise.

entries.name: agent
entries.purpose: 声明专用agent构造计划，显式模型别名及可选默认二参learner，不训练。

entries.name: environment
entries.signature: environment NAME { observation: f32[N]; action: f32[A]; feedback: f32[F]; reset: FUNCTION; step: FUNCTION; }
entries.purpose: 声明同步WGT环境状态与reset/step schema；实例构造reset一次。

entries.name: learn
entries.purpose: 整批collect成功后释放目标policy保护并调用一次具名同步二参learner。

entries.name: __agent
entries.purpose: Compiler-only agent constructor; source __ names rejected.

entries.name: __environment
entries.purpose: Compiler-only environment constructor; source __ names rejected.

entries.name: __record
entries.purpose: Compiler-only bounded finite record literal; source __ names rejected.

entries.name: async
entries.purpose: 创建冷用户future；显式纯数据参数与返回值；第一阶段拒绝资源/模型异步执行。

entries.name: tasks
entries.purpose: 同步函数内有界任务作用域，正常join、失败取消并等待在途IO；首期不支持嵌套。

entries.name: await
entries.purpose: 驱动冷future或等待作用域task，拒绝任意同步值。

entries.name: spawn
entries.purpose: 在tasks内启动作用域子任务，禁止默认脱离。

entries.name: sleep
entries.purpose: 仅async fn：固定阻塞池等待0..30000整数毫秒，返回null；不是定时器reactor。

entries.name: reload
entries.signature: reload model TARGET from PATH using OPTIMIZER; | reload checkpoint TARGET from PATH;
entries.purpose: 同句柄同结构原子重载；model新优化器，checkpoint恢复状态，运行时revision递增并使旧梯度失效。

entries.name: save
entries.purpose: 显式原子保存 model/checkpoint/json/text；默认拒绝覆盖，父目录必须存在，路径按脚本根目录解析。

entries.name: load
entries.purpose: 读取 model/checkpoint/json/text；model必填using新优化器，checkpoint恢复已记录优化器，不执行训练或main。

entries.name: assert
entries.purpose: 条件必须bool且仅求值一次；仅失败时求消息。兼容两实参assert(condition,message)保持急求值。

entries.name: __record_field
entries.purpose: Compiler-only record field projection; source __ calls rejected. RecordBatch columns retain row order and charge traversal; plain indexed lists are rejected.

entries.name: __probabilities
entries.purpose: Compiler-only target for typed value.probabilities; source calls with __ prefix are rejected. Stable softmax for logits, strict validation and identity for probabilities, ordinary f32 rejected.

entries.name: __graph
entries.purpose: Compiler-only sequential model construction.

entries.name: __adaptive
entries.purpose: Compiler-only forward model construction.

entries.name: true
entries.purpose: Boolean literal.

entries.name: false
entries.purpose: Boolean literal.

entries.name: null
entries.purpose: Null value; also the implicit function return.

entries.name: f32
entries.purpose: Fixed-shape 32-bit floating-point tensor; supported ranks depend on declaration.

entries.name: logits
entries.purpose: Finite, nonempty mutually exclusive category scores. Explicit output metadata survives model persistence and function values. .probabilities applies stable softmax along the category axis. Output declarations only; no binary logit type.

entries.name: probabilities
entries.purpose: Finite mutually exclusive category vector, each value strictly in [0,1], sum within absolute 1e-5 of 1. Conversion validates and preserves values; no renormalization. Sampling scales by actual total mass and skips zero-mass entries. CPU native implementation; GPU categorical path not verified.

entries.name: prob
entries.purpose: Probability parameter represented by a logit; trainable initial value strictly in (0,1), frozen permits endpoints; reads f32[1]. Initializer required.

entries.name: linear
entries.purpose: Sequential affine layer; out required, in defaults to preceding width, bias defaults to 1.

entries.name: relu
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: tanh
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: sigmoid
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: identity
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: __predict
entries.purpose: Compiler lowering only; unavailable in source

entries.name: __train_step
entries.purpose: Compiler-only train block lowering; source __ calls rejected.
